description: Returns Huntay AzerTürk's open slots for a 30-minute intro video call (Google Meet), read live from his booking calendar (Monday–Friday, 10:00–18:00 Istanbul time). Use when the user wants to schedule a call with Huntay AzerTürk.

days.description: Number of days to search (default 7, max 30).

from.description: First day to search, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

timeZone.description: The user's IANA time zone, e.g. "Europe/Berlin". Defaults to Europe/Istanbul.
